key_technical_lessons: MB-Lab T-pose has arms at ~45 degrees, not 90. upperarm rotation of (10, 5, 55) Z brings arms to sides.
BONE parent positions at bone TAIL. Offset = bone.head_local - bone.tail_local.
ARMATURE_AUTO for deformable body mesh ONLY. BONE parent for all rigid accessories.
Cycles with RTX 4000 CUDA at 64 samples + denoising: ~5s per frame, significantly better than EEVEE for metals.
MediaPipe 0.10.33 uses Tasks API (PoseLandmarker), not legacy solutions.pose.
Blender 4.2 needed for MPFB2 but MB-Lab works and is sufficient.
The animation pipeline MUST verify each pose individually before proceeding to the next.
